note: lc5-delta-time-1123 (docs/336, WRITTEN, NOT RUN; TIMING, needs quiet machine: Spotify, IDE and java closed, other CPU < 10%): deadrefdelta off vs on (deadrefslimuse ON in both arms; it acts only with deadrefdelta on; build lc5delta2) in one load per world (BP / IP / SV), deadrefcadence ON in both arms. Run only after lc5-delta-correct-1123 passed. Smoke first. Each job: 25 min, 5-min slices, ABBA. Each on slice starts unseeded (the off arm adds nothing to the index), so its first object pass is a full seed walk: the on arm understates the gain. Read: node tools/harness/loopcost-report.ts --arm deadrefdelta <tag>-ab-fixes.jsonl; node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts <tag>. Gate (docs/333 §6): no regression in our ms/s or hitch p99 / p99.9 / max beyond noise. Est ~1 h 50 min.
